title: Consumer build and promotion receipts
summary: A hosted promotion records a verified attempt receipt naming the product and consumer commits it deployed. A later run whose bound workflow stage would ship the same pair reuses that delivery instead of dispatching: the newest succeeded run on an environment of the same name, in any flow, must hold a receipt for every bound project naming this run's release lineage and bound commit. The stage's fleet rehearsal gate runs first, so a target with no migration preflight coverage rehearses or refuses rather than being reused. The receipt is copied into the reusing run, `bound_sources.delivery_reuse` names the reused run, and warm-up still runs. Factory completion uses the retrying GitHub Actions waiter. Warm-up retries only the deploy driver’s shared transient read codes on its shared backoff schedule; six 25s read attempts plus 62s backoff take about 212s before refusal. Any difference, `--fresh`, or an older serving build dispatches as before, still behind the rehearsal gate.
